title: Try v1 operations with ten-minute project console sessions

endpoints.before: Trying GET /v1/autocomplete in the API Reference required pasting an existing API key secret.
endpoints.after: The project owner can also try GET /v1/autocomplete with a console-only credential lasting at most ten minutes, bound to the same dashboard login. Requests share a stable per-project console quota and count toward project analytics and endpoint alerts. Public API key behavior is preserved.
